subject: POC gap assessment & action sprint — alignment and owners
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Park <tom.park@orionretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC gap assessment & action sprint — alignment and owners

Tom / Orion team — thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we keep momentum going. Please review and flag anything that needs to move or be re-prioritized.

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: surface low-latency product search re-rank and intent extraction in your storefront for top 5k SKUs.
- Business success metrics: +8% conversion on search within 30 days, 95th percentile latency < 250ms for re-rank calls, and false-positive rate for intent extraction < 3%.
- Data scope: clickstream + product catalog (S3), API-based product metadata, and a small labeled QA set for intent accuracy testing.

Proposed POC scope (2-week sprint)
1) Connectivity & infra readiness (week 0): network allowlist, S3 read test, minimal IAM roles. Owner: Ben C.
2) Baseline ingest + simple eval (days 1–4): ingest 100k events and run baseline re-rank. Owner: Marissa C.
3) Model tuning & KV cache config (days 5–9): short-loop tuning and latency profiling. Owner: Rachel K.
4) Acceptance & readout (days 10–14): run the acceptance tests tied to the three success metrics above and readout. Owner: Sean G.

Attachments: poc-gap-matrix.xlsx (matrix of requirements + where the gaps are), network-requirements.pdf (port/IP checklist).

Asks for you this week
- Confirm the three success metrics above or propose edits by EOD Fri (Dec 18).
- Confirm an IT contact we can work with to get allowlist/IP access and a test S3 bucket.
- Share the prioritized test cases for intent extraction (top 8 intents) — sample CSV is fine.

Suggested kickoff: Tue Dec 21 at 10:00 AM PT — we can do a 30-minute run-through of the runbook and ownership. If that works, Ben will open the infra ticket and Marissa will schedule the ingest window.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC gap assessment & action sprint — alignment and owners

Thanks Rachel — solid note and clear plan. A few clarifications from our side:

- Success metrics: the conversion target (+8%) is fine as a stretch target; for acceptance we need a gating metric on click-through rather than conversion (shorter window) — can we add CTR lift >= 5% as a secondary check?
- Security: we will require a short security checklist (list of hashed logs to be retained during the POC, retention 30 days). Our security lead wants that in writing before we open ports.
- Timeline: our infra lead says they can start the allowlist work on Dec 20; Dec 21 kickoff works for us but we may only have reduced availability for two people on the 21st (timezone overlap).

IT contact: Aaron Lin (aaron.lin@orionretail.com) — he can start the allowlist. QA contact will be the QA Lead on cc.

Can you confirm who will own the security checklist and whether Redwood can hold logs for the 30-day window (we understand this is a temporary store for the POC only)?

Best,
Tom Park
Director of Product — Orion Retail
